c. 1939
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten message by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
(WRITTEN ON THE FLYLEAF OF VOLUME ONE, THE CONCEPTION, OF THE "MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD") BOOKS
Dear Reader:
TO KNOW IS TO APPRECIATE".
The following pages beautifully introduce The Blessed Virgin Mary Immaculate.
Learn to know her that you may love Heaven and heavenly things.
Fr. Solanus, O. M. Cap.
WRITTEN ON THE FLYLEAF OF VOLUME TWO, THE INCARNATION, OF THE "MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD" BOOKS
Dear Reader: -- TO KNOW IS TO APPRECIATE".
Look at the "front piece" in this book and you have a glance at what it contains -- if you can read the picture. It is the Blessed Virgin Mary's own book -- her autobiography I call it.
Fr. Solanus, O. M. Cap. WRITTEN ON THE FLYLEAF OF VOLUME THREE, THE TRANSFIXION VOLUME, OF THE "MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD" BOOKS
Dear Reader: --
We've all had had a tast of sorrw. How little we realiz what a benefit it is that we do have such experience now and then.
In these pages you will learn something of how we ought to love sorrows and pains in this life. for 'Tis pain that often purifies the heart.
Get acquainted with the Queen of Martyrs. God's Mother Suffering. Fr. Solanus
Original in possession of: Mrs. Arthur (Georgia) Gietzen 22237 Virginia St. E. Detroit, Mich. 48021
